ridges: 2–6 groups, at least 12 samples per group, up to 1,200 samples overall.
waterfall: 4–12 items. Opening total plus changes must match the final total.
fan: 6–16 items. Completed values cannot exceed targets.
interval: 3–10 items; low ≤ estimate ≤ high. Provide intervalLabel.
diverging: 4–10 items on a shared symmetric linear scale.
parallel: 3–6 objects × 3–6 dimensions sharing one unit and scale.
ecdf: 16–300 original observations; ties form one cumulative jump.
cohort: 2–8 consecutive monthly cohorts, 3–12 observation months. Unit must be %.
bullet: 3–8 items; value and target must not exceed high. Provide three bandLabels.
funnel: 4–8 stages. The first count must be positive; later counts cannot increase.
gantt: 4–10 tasks ordered by start date, within 366 days.
ledger: 3–8 metrics × 4–24 consecutive months on a shared value axis.
lollipop: 4–12 items, measured from zero in input order.
pareto: 4–10 categories with at least one positive count, sorted by descending count.
violin: 2–5 groups, 12–160 samples each, with shared bandwidth and scales.
correlation: 3–6 variables × 8–120 complete samples. Constant variables are undefined.
marimekko: Complete 3–6 groups × 2–5 components; each group total must be positive.
smallmultiples: 2–6 series × 6–36 dates with a common date set. Irregular spacing and missing values are supported.
range: 8–40 dates; low ≤ open and close ≤ high. Irregular date spacing is allowed.
groupedbar: 3–8 categories × 2–4 complete series. Negative values are allowed.
ribbon: 6–48 unique dates; low ≤ estimate ≤ high. Provide intervalLabel.
heatmap: Complete 3–8 row × 3–10 column matrix. Use null for missing values.
pyramid: 4–10 categories with nonnegative values on both sides. Provide two sideLabels.
rose: 4–12 categories with at least one positive value. Area encodes value.
radar: 2–4 series × 4–8 complete axes. Supply a positive common max.
trajectory: 6–30 unique dates. Define axes.x and axes.y with units.
donut: 3–10 unique categories, nonnegative values and a positive total.
contour: Complete equally spaced 6–20 × 6–20 grid. Define axes.x/y and their units.
hexbin: 20–600 unique samples. Define axes.x/y; binRadius is 8–24.
step: 6–48 unique dates with at least two measured values. Missing values use null.
difference: 6–48 unique dates. Provide two distinct seriesLabels.
scatter3d: 6–80 unique objects, 1–4 groups. Define axes.x/y/z and their units.
bars3d: Complete 3–6 × 3–6 matrix, nonnegative values and a positive total.
surface3d: Complete equally spaced 4–16 × 4–16 grid. Define axes.x/y/z.
trajectory3d: 6–60 unique dates. Define axes.x/y/z with units.
pie: 3–10 unique categories, nonnegative values and a positive total.
polarline: 8–24 unique equally spaced cycle positions, nonnegative values and a positive total.
horizon: 8–60 valid dates, 2–5 complete series. Missing values use null.
cycleplot: 3–8 cycles, 4–12 seasonal positions. Keep all combinations; missing values use null.
eventline: 6–18 events, 2–3 groups, up to 6 events per group.
network: 6–24 nodes, 5–50 positive undirected links. No self-loops or duplicates.
directedchord: 3–8 nodes, up to 40 positive directed links. No self-loops.
parallelsets: 2–6 categories per axis, up to 36 unique paths. Define axes.a/b/c.
survival: 2–4 groups, 6–40 records each. Nonnegative duration and explicit censoring status.
vectorfield: 16–100 unique coordinates. Define axes.x/y in the same spatial unit.
voronoi: 8–50 unique coordinates, 1–4 groups. Define axes.x/y in the same spatial unit.
gauge: One record; min < max, with value and target within that range.
likert: 2–7 questions, five responses per question totaling 100%. Define response order.
bubble3d: 6–60 unique objects, 1–4 groups. Define axes.x/y/z/size and their units.
errorbar: 2–5 groups, 3–60 independent samples each, with unique labels.
paired: 6–50 unique samples. Define the two observations in pairLabels.
regression: 4–300 independent observations with variation in X. Define axes.x/y and units.
blandaltman: 6–200 paired measurements in one unit. Define methodLabels.
forest: 4–12 studies; 0 < lower ≤ estimate ≤ upper, positive integer n. Define intervalLabel.
volcano: 20–1,000 unique objects; 0 < padj ≤ 1. Define qThreshold and fcThreshold.
pca: 8–300 samples, 1–5 groups. pc1Variance + pc2Variance ≤ 100. Supply calculated scores.
roc: 1–3 models, 8–300 samples each. Use the same samples with both classes present.
precisionrecall: 1–3 models, 8–300 samples each. Use the same samples with both classes present.
confusion: Complete 2–6-class square matrix of nonnegative counts. Each row total must be positive.
calibration: 8–300 samples per model, score in [0,1], bins from 3 to 12.
residual: 8–300 independent samples. Observations and predictions must share a unit.
dose: 4–12 positive doses, 3–30 repeats per dose. Define doseUnit.
learning: 6–120 increasing integer epochs, nonnegative losses. Missing values use null.
scree: All 3–16 components ordered by decreasing eigenvalue; nonnegative with a positive total.
upset: Declare 2–5 sets and 4–20 unique nonempty exclusive intersections with positive integer counts.
manhattan: 20–1,000 loci. Declare chromosome names and lengths; 0 < pvalue ≤ 1.
metafunnel: 6–100 studies; se > 0. Define referenceEffect. Log ratios must be transformed beforehand.
column: 2–24 distinct categories. Positive, negative and zero values are allowed.
singleline: 2–90 equally spaced periods with at least two measured observations.
area: 2–90 equally spaced periods; nonnegative values or null.
xy: 3–300 unique objects. Define axes.x/y and units.
percentcolumn: 2–16 periods, 2–5 complete series. Every period total must be positive.
percentarea: 3–60 equally spaced periods, 2–5 complete series. Every period total must be positive.
comboline: 3–24 equally spaced periods with nonnegative values. Define bar and line seriesLabels.
kpi: 1–4 unique metrics with individual units. When previous ≤ 0, only absolute change is shown.
